events.title: 🍜Character Introduction｜Meruru🍜
events.summary: Meruru / A Human ManMomomochi Town, where our story takes place, is a fiercely competitive ramen hotspot lined with popular restaurants. One shop drawing particular attention is Meruru Umama-tei, which opened just a year ago.Its owner, Meruru, is a master ramen chef who carries on the tradition of Kotoneko family ramen—a fantastical style passed down on another planet. events.title: 🍜Character Introduction｜Mint🍜
events.summary: Mint / Zashiki-warashiZashiki-warashi are yokai with a mission: to attach themselves to humans and bring them happiness. They come into the world by falling from the sky, already in adult form. Older members raise the newcomers, and together they live by helping one another.Mint is the youngest of them all—only one year old and still being raised by Niisui. events.title: 🍜Character Introduction｜Dinette🍜
events.summary: Dinette / A Young Human ManLovingly raised by the supernatural being Kagaya, Dinette is a kind soul with a slightly unusual upbringing.What does happiness mean to each person? What does it mean to wish for someone else’s happiness? Dinette is always reflecting on these questions, sincerely seeking to understand others’ feelings and what makes them happy.He shares his heartfelt kindness freely with everyone he meets. events.title: 🍜Character Introduction｜Kagaya🍜
events.summary: Kagaya / Supernatural BeingAn enormous eye and a terrifying face. If you met Kagaya in the world of this story, you’d probably be frightened at first.But Kagaya himself is kind and sensitive. He loves art, takes life at his own pace, and has a surprisingly playful side.The more time you spend with him, the more familiar his once-frightening appearance becomes.
